cftc_crosscheck.scheduled_adapter_report_type: Traders in Financial Futures — futures only
cftc_crosscheck.research_crosscheck_report_type: Traders in Financial Futures — futures and options combined
cftc_crosscheck.unresolved_difference: The two public files differ by five CME contracts in the weekly change (250,000 XRP-equivalent); cause not established. Preserve both series.
cftc_crosscheck.model_mapping: The scheduled adapter uses the futures-only file; the combined report is supplemental research. Do not substitute combined change for the scheduled futures-only feature.
cftc_crosscheck.interpretation: Gross contract-equivalent open interest, not cash, net directional exposure, unique risk or spot flow.

coinbase_q3_2026.average_usdc_on_coinbase_products: Company reports an all-time high; exact amount not stated in the reviewed excerpt.
coinbase_q3_2026.circle_agreement: Renewed on the same terms in 2026.
coinbase_q3_2026.xrp_disclosure: The reviewed 10-Q contains no XRP-specific holdings or collateral disclosure; this is absence of disclosure, not proof of zero exposure.

circle_q3_2026.binance_commercial_relationship: Circle describes Binance as making USDC broadly available across its product suite and using USDC as a dollar stablecoin for corporate treasury.
circle_q3_2026.important_scope: Circle's USDC-on-platform metric is Circle's own platform, not Coinbase balances. Circle distribution expense and Coinbase stablecoin revenue are different accounting measures and must not be netted.

mica.classification: USDC is the first significant e-money token classified under MiCA.
mica.supervision_from_effective_date: EBA takes direct responsibility for own funds, reserve assets, liquidity requirements and recovery/redemption plans; ACPR retains governance, qualifying holdings, fit-and-proper, outsourcing and conflicts.
mica.status_at_run: ANNOUNCED; EFFECTIVE DATE IS TWO DAYS AFTER THIS CAPTURE

legal_entity_separation.caveat: National trust-bank charters, state limited-purpose trust charters and stablecoin issuing entities are distinct legal persons and permissions; do not collapse them into one license.

rails_and_collateral.coinbase_xrp: XRP is listed as eligible collateral for USDC borrowing through Morpho on Base, with Coinbase as interface. This is not native XRPL lending.
rails_and_collateral.coinbase_rlusd: Coinbase supports RLUSD trading and XRPL/Base/Ethereum transfers; Global Exchange collateral support was announced as future, not verified live.
rails_and_collateral.standard_chartered_lmax: Standard Chartered custody support for RLUSD on XRPL is announced; LMAX collateral integration is planned, not verified live.
rails_and_collateral.bny: BNY announced XRP and RLUSD custody support. Custody does not establish proprietary purchases or collateral utilization.
rails_and_collateral.ripple_circle: No direct Ripple-Circle equity or operating partnership was established in the reviewed primary filings. Shared counterparties (Coinbase, SBI) do not prove a direct relationship.

sbi_circle_ripple.circle_sbi_japan: 50/50 Circle-SBI Japan JV, distinct from the strategic equity investment.
sbi_circle_ripple.circle_equity: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank each invested $25M in Circle; distinct from the JV.
sbi_circle_ripple.ripple_equity: SBI Holdings' approximate 9-10% Ripple stake remains based on public disclosures, not an exact current share register.
sbi_circle_ripple.remittance: SBI Remit corridors in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia explicitly use XRP as a bridge; corridor volumes and actual XRP conversion throughput remain undisclosed.
sbi_circle_ripple.separation: SBI VC Trade RLUSD distribution and JPYSC lending are separate from XRP bridge conversion.

prediction_engine_gaps_confirmed.feature_drift: Univariate PSI-style feature drift diagnostics; no demonstrated label/concept-drift monitoring.
prediction_engine_gaps_confirmed.action: Keep manual event research separate from scheduled feature admission. Prioritize a versioned macro/event adapter, point-in-time release timestamps, raw replay and source-independence controls before forecast issuance.

source_independence_and_counterhypothese.circle_coinbase: SEC 10-Qs are primary filings but report different accounting measures; not nettable.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.circle_binance: Direct Circle equity and USDC distribution relationship; no XRP investment evidence.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.cftc: Official CFTC contract positions are lagged; futures-only and combined files differ by five CME contracts in weekly change.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.etf: Aggregators share issuer-file inputs; not independent confirmation; cash versus in-kind and custody transfer unresolved.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.exchange_wallets: Single labeled-wallet methodology; new-wallet additions and custody reserves distort naive totals.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.spot: Kraken and OKX observations are asynchronous and USDT normalization is approximate; no arbitrage inference.
source_independence_and_counterhypothese.custody: BNY, Coinbase and BitGo custody roles are not evidence of beneficial ownership, proprietary holdings or market purchases.
